info.title: Replay Session - Computer Use Agent Skill
info.description: Instructions for a computer use agent working on an Amazon WorkSpaces Applications stack with Replay Session (ReplaySessionEnabled) turned on, where every desktop action is recorded for later review.

servers.description: Windows Desktop on a stack with Replay Session enabled

post.summary: Find the ID that names this session's recording

steps: Report the mcpSessionId field: the recording is delivered under agentaccess/replay-session/year=YYYY/month=MM/day=DD/<mcpSessionId>/ in the stack's S3 bucket.
tips: get_session_info is read-only and is not captured as a frame in the recording.
The workSpacesSessionId field is the streaming session, not the recording's folder name.

post.summary: Take desktop actions on a recorded stack

steps: Plan the next action, then take it once.
Take a screenshot only when you need to see the result.
tips: Each desktop action is captured before it runs: the screen plus the exact tool call and arguments.
Everything you type is kept in the transcript. Never type passwords, tokens or other secrets.
A short, deliberate sequence of actions produces a clearer audit trail than trial and error.
x-agent-instructions.verification: Each action returned a success result.

post.summary: Handle an action blocked by Replay Session

steps: If a tool result starts with 'Replay Session enabled but action blocked', the action did not run.
Report the full message, including any KMS error code and operation it names, and stop.
tips: Capture is fail-closed: an action that cannot be recorded is rejected rather than run unrecorded.
A message naming a KMS error means the stack's KmsKeyArn cannot be used; retrying the same action will fail again until the key policy is fixed.
x-agent-instructions.verification: You reported the blocking message instead of retrying.
